Boost your review collection with QR codes & Review links Getting more product reviews is key to building trust and increasing conversions. But asking for reviews only via email isn't always enough - especially for in-person experiences like retail stores, pop-ups, or order inserts. That's where QR codes and review links come in. They make it easy to collect reviews on the spot. What are QR Codes and Review links? QR codes and review links in Loox are tools that let you request reviews from customers who have placed an order, without relying solely on post-purchase emails. After scanning a QR code or clicking a review link, the customer simply enters their email. If there’s a recent order to review, Loox will automatically send them a review request. Both tools lead to the same review form, but they’re designed for different moments: QR codes are great for physical placements - on packaging, inserts, or signage at in-person events. Review links work best in digital channels - like email campaigns, SMS, or DMs. This gives you the flexibility to collect reviews wherever your customers are. When to use them? QR codes and review links are ideal for: Pop-up shops and physical retail events Product inserts and thank-you cards Collaborations with influencers or affiliates Follow-ups via SMS or direct messages Post-purchase flows in your newsletter or email campaigns Loyalty program check-ins or community updates Best practices for using QR codes and Review links Give context Don’t just drop a QR code or link - explain what it’s for. Make the request clear, personal, and appealing. Example : "Tried our product? Scan to leave a review & get 10% off your next order." Place the QR code where it matters Think through the customer journey and make sure the QR code shows up at the right moment. Reviewers.com is a gifting platform where brands share free products with a community of vetted reviewers in exchange for high-quality, honest, and authentic video reviews. How do you vet your Reviewers? Every Reviewer in our community has been carefully vetted. Before anyone can participate, they submit a sample video that we personally review - checking for authenticity, fluent English, clear sound, and good lighting. Only those who meet our high standards are approved as Reviewers. As Reviewers participate in campaigns, we apply those same standards to every video they submit, ensuring they maintain and improve quality over time. Can I select my preiority reviewers? You can define the age, gender, and location of your Reviewers. You can then browse through our Reviewers and select the ones you’d like to give first access to your campaigns. Add qualifying questions to achieve an even closer match between relevant Reviewers and your product. Once you create a campaign, your offer first goes out to your Priority Reviewers, and then after 24 hours, to our entire community that fits your audience, boosting awareness and recognition for your brand. Reviewers are based in the US at the moment. About your campaigns What is a campaign? A campaign is how you get your products into the hands of real Reviewers. You create a campaign for a specific product, gift it to 5-10 vetted reviewers, and they share their honest experience in a review. Each campaign is tied to a specific product page (PDP), with the option to include variants so reviewers can choose the item that suits them best. You can gift 5 or 10 items per campaign, with each reviewer receiving one item. Creating a campaign takes just a few clicks: select your product, choose the number of items to gift, define your target audience, and optionally customize the review timing. You can also add a campaign brief and include up to three screening questions to ensure you’re reaching the right reviewers. ‍ ▶ Watch: How to create a campaign Can I give a brief to Reviewers? Yes, you can add a suggested brief for Reviewers participating in your campaign to help them understand what’s important to you and your brand - whether that's highlighting specific features, demonstrating unboxing, or capturing your product in action. How do Reviewers place the order? Your campaign goes out to everyone in our community who fits your specified audience. Those who claim the offer first are directed to your product page, where we provide them with a free discount for the item, including shipping. They place the order on your site, and you process it as you would any other order. You’ll see all your orders within your Shopify admin. All Reviewers.com discount codes are prefixed with “RVS-”, so you’ll be able to easily identify the orders associated with your Reviewers.com campaigns. Where do the reviews live, and what can I do with them? Once your reviews come in, you’ll be able to manage them within your Shopify admin. You can export your reviews at any time and retain full usage rights. If you are using the Loox product reviews app , they will go directly into your review widgets. If you are using a different product reviews app, you can import them easily into your existing widgets.
